purpose: Attribute frozen SW0126 seed-1 endpoint changes using the original QCC actual-component-spike readout.

fixed_inference.readout: spike_synchrony_components over actual emitted component spikes

provenance_and_order.source: SW0097 seed-1 positive_frozen checkpoint, strict-loaded into the original core factory before optional history-adapter attachment
provenance_and_order.trained_arms: Must pass the frozen SW0126 pilot_run.valid_training contract before checkpoint load.
provenance_and_order.validation_gamma: Existing registered SW0097 cached validation gamma is validated directly; no encoder is retrained or substituted. Preflight compares native and copied rollout/QCC labels on two TRAIN and two validation examples, then strict-loads all four model arms and runs a finite actual-spike/QCC smoke on two validation examples per arm.
provenance_and_order.ground_truth: Prediction uses no GT. All four 320-grid prediction arrays are written, SHA-verified, and reread before opening the canonical HDF5 mask dataset.
provenance_and_order.scoring: Existing SW0118 standard patch scorer on modal 8x8 CLEVR masks. Source97 per-image values for all three metrics must reproduce within 1e-10; otherwise preserve a failed result and do not report a successful attribution.

interpretation: Frozen-checkpoint comparison only. It does not establish that any individual gate, event, membrane, or training mechanism caused a score change, and it does not alter SW0126 training or readout settings.
